CLUMPY allocator

Source: R/alloc_clumpy.R
alloc_clumpy_spec.Rd

Stochastic, unbiased allocation after Mazy (2022, Ch. 3), reimplemented from CLUMPY. The whole pivot-selection and patch-growth routine runs in C++ (allocate_clumpy_cpp()). The method is chosen from the patch parameters in alloc_params_t:

  • uSAM (Unbiased Simple Allocation Method, Mazy sec. 3.4.1) when every transition is mono-pixel (mean_patch_size == 1 and patch_size_variance == 0): one MuST (Multinomial Sampling Test, Mazy App. 3.B; the same test the reference clumpy calls "GART") pass per anterior class, each selected pivot allocated as a single cell. Quantity of change is enforced in expectation.

  • uPAM (Unbiased Patch Allocation Method, Mazy sec. 3.4.2, Fig. 3.2) otherwise: iterative MuST with a per-transition pixel quota and sampling without replacement. Affordable here because evoland.plus's potentials come from a fixed fitted model, so the marginal density does not need to be re-estimated between patches.

Multi-pixel patches require uPAM; "uSAM with patches larger than one pixel" is not a valid method, hence the automatic selection rather than a user switch.

The per-cell pivot probability is divided by the mean patch area (the 1/E(sigma) factor, Mazy Fig. 3.2) so that the allocated quantity of change matches the target transition rate; without it allocation over-shoots by roughly the mean patch size.

The patch parameters are read from alloc_params_t: mean_patch_size and patch_size_variance give the patch-area distribution, patch_elongation its shape.

The allocator works on a raster built from coords_t, so it needs coordinate points on a regular grid. R's random number generator drives it, so set.seed() makes a realisation replay.

Usage

alloc_clumpy_spec(
  area_dist = c("lognormal", "normal"),
  avoid_aggregation = TRUE,
  batch_size = 0L,
  default_elongation = 0.5
)

Arguments

area_dist

Character; patch-area distribution, "lognormal" (default) or "normal" (Gaussian with sd = sqrt(patch_size_variance), clamped to >= 1).

avoid_aggregation

Logical; if TRUE (default) uPAM patches that would merge with an existing patch fail and allocate nothing (clumpy GaussianPatcher semantics). Ignored for the mono-pixel uSAM path.

batch_size

Integer; uPAM pivots attempted per MuST re-draw. 0 (default) auto-scales to ~1% of each class's source pool, bounding the number of MuST passes so large rasters stay tractable; > 0 is an explicit cap (1 = strict uPAM); < 0 processes all candidates in a single pass. Ignored for uSAM.

default_elongation

Numeric in [0, 1]; patch elongation for transitions whose patch_elongation is missing (0 isometric, 1 linear).

Value

An allocator specification for allocate().

References

Mazy, 2022 (https://theses.hal.science/tel-04382012v1), Ch. 3.
